name: Staithe Marshes Estate
blurb: Drained grazing marsh in the Broads, kept for the shooting and the tax position. A dyke, a windpump and a lot of potential reed.

stages: Sluices open; shallow flood across the field.
Wet fen; cranes on the pools.

ranger: Drained, ditched and fenced for grazing. The marsh is still under there, waiting.
Sluices open and a shallow flood across the field. The reeds are creeping back.
Reedbed's thickening. I heard a bittern boom at dusk, first time in my life.
Wet fen with cranes on the pools. Staithe marshes as they were before the drains.
